A line qualifies when every move stays within the allowed loss from the mover’s best legal choice and every position stays inside the evaluation band. Both sliders use pawns. A **ply** is one move by one player.

```{=html}
<section id="opening-filters" class="rc" aria-label="Viable openings">
  <p id="of-status" role="status">Loading opening data…</p>
  <noscript>Enable JavaScript to explore the opening filters.</noscript>
  <div class="rc-grid of-filters">
    <div class="rc-card of-filter">
      <label class="of-label" for="of-loss">Maximum loss per move <output for="of-loss" id="of-loss-value"></output></label>
      <div id="of-loss-ticks" class="of-ticks rc-note tabular-nums" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <input id="of-loss" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="20">
      <div id="of-loss-odds" class="of-ticks rc-note tabular-nums" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div id="of-loss-note" class="rc-note"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="rc-card of-filter">
      <label class="of-label" for="of-band">Evaluation band around zero <output for="of-band" id="of-band-value"></output></label>
      <div id="of-band-ticks" class="of-ticks rc-note tabular-nums" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <input id="of-band" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="100">
      <div id="of-band-odds" class="of-ticks rc-note tabular-nums" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div id="of-band-note" class="rc-note"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p class="rc-note" id="of-count-note">Percentages use all legal possibilities at the indicated ply. A move order counts as played when a game followed that exact sequence. A position counts if a game reached it by any move order at the same ply.</p>
    <div class="of-count-tables" id="of-tables"></div>
  </div>
  <section class="rc-card">
    <div class="of-lines-heading">
      <h2 id="of-lines-title">Move orders that meet both filters</h2>
      <label class="rc-field">Show move orders after
      <select id="of-sample-ply">
        <option value="1">After 1. White</option>
        <option value="2">After 1… Black</option>
        <option value="3">After 2. White</option>
        <option value="4">After 2… Black</option>
        <option value="5" selected>After 3. White</option>
      </select>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="rc-note" id="of-line-count"><span aria-live="polite" id="of-line-total"></span> · Game counts are for the exact moves shown.</div>
    <div id="of-scroll" class="rc-table-box" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-labelledby="of-lines-title">
      <table class="rc-table">
        <thead id="of-sort"><tr>
          <th scope="col"><button type="button" data-sort="pgn" aria-label="Sort by PGN">PGN <span aria-hidden="true">↕</span></button></th>
          <th scope="col" class="text-end"><button type="button" data-sort="loss" aria-label="Sort by Largest move loss">Largest move loss <span aria-hidden="true">↕</span></button></th>
          <th scope="col" class="text-end"><button type="button" data-sort="cp" aria-label="Sort by Final eval (White)">Final eval (White) <span aria-hidden="true">↕</span></button></th>
          <th scope="col" class="text-end"><button type="button" data-sort="games" aria-label="Sort by Lichess games">Lichess games <span aria-hidden="true">↕</span></button></th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody id="of-lines"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </section>
  <p class="rc-note">Evaluations come from the repertoire database. Stockfish 19 filled missing scores at 100,000 nodes per position. Win percentages use its full-material model. Game counts cover rated, non-tournament standard games on Lichess from January 2013 through July 2026, excluding known bots.</p>
  <details class="rc-card of-estimates">
    <summary>How far does the tree grow at the widest settings?</summary>
    <p class="rc-note" id="of-estimate-note">Maximum move loss 1.00 pawn · evaluation band ±1.00. Counts are exact through ply 5. Plies 6–8 use 256 sampled continuations from qualifying five-ply move orders.</p>
    <div class="rc-table-box"><table class="rc-table" aria-label="Widest-setting move-order estimates" aria-describedby="of-estimate-note">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Ply</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Surviving move orders</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Share of all legal orders</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Sampling interval</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="of-forecast"></tbody>
    </table></div>
    <p class="rc-note" id="of-changes"></p>
    <p class="rc-note" id="of-workload"></p>
    <div class="rc-table-box"><table class="rc-table" aria-label="Stockfish fill estimates">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Ply</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Positions needing scores</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">95% sampling interval</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Estimated engine time</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="of-engine-time"></tbody>
    </table></div>
    <p class="rc-note">Ply 6 has an exact count of outstanding evaluations. Plies 7 and 8 use 64 sampled walks, weighting each missing position by the number of qualifying routes to it and accounting for earlier fills. Times cover additional engine work at each ply. <span id="of-rate"></span></p>
  </details>
</section>
<script defer src="filters.js?v=590d9c9d227e"></script>
```
